# ForgeFlow Developer / IP / Confidentiality Agreement

**Legal Pack Version:** `2026-09-IR-2`

This repository-level agreement is intended for authorized ForgeFlow contributors while ForgeFlow is an unincorporated startup operated by **Hossein Rahimi**. It supplements any employment, contractor, compensation or services arrangement and does not waive mandatory rights under Iranian law.

## 1. Parties and purpose

The contributor using the GitHub account that accepts this Legal Pack is the **Developer**. **Hossein Rahimi** is the current ForgeFlow Founder and recipient of transferable/economic ForgeFlow project rights until a future ForgeFlow company is incorporated.

Access to private ForgeFlow repositories, systems, documentation and infrastructure is granted only so the Developer can perform authorized ForgeFlow work.

## 2. ForgeFlow and Work Product

**ForgeFlow** includes `ForgeFlow-AI-Core`, related repositories, services, APIs, infrastructure, data models, AI workflows, deployment systems, documentation, designs, branding and future versions or derivatives.

**Work Product** means software and other protectable material created or materially contributed by the Developer specifically within assigned ForgeFlow duties, including source code, scripts, algorithms, APIs, schemas, databases, architecture, AI agents, prompts, evaluations, integrations, UI/UX implementation, documentation, tests, specifications, research, improvements and related technical material.

## 3. Transferable and economic rights

To the fullest extent permitted by the laws of the Islamic Republic of Iran, transferable/economic rights that the Developer owns or may acquire in Work Product created within assigned ForgeFlow duties are assigned to, or where applicable vest in, **Hossein Rahimi** as the current Founder, employer/commissioning party and recipient of ForgeFlow project IP.

Where a transferable right cannot be assigned in the form stated above, the Developer grants the Founder the broadest licence permitted by applicable law to use, reproduce, modify, adapt, integrate, distribute, commercialize, license and otherwise exploit that Work Product for ForgeFlow.

Nothing in this section overrides mandatory employment, inventor-compensation or other non-waivable rights.

## 4. Future ForgeFlow company

ForgeFlow is currently pre-incorporation. The Developer agrees, to the extent permitted by law, that the Founder may later transfer or assign the economic rights, licences and contractual benefits obtained under this Legal Pack to a company or successor formed to own or operate ForgeFlow without that transfer creating any equity or ownership right for the Developer.

The Developer will reasonably cooperate with documentation needed to confirm that chain of title, provided it does not materially expand the Developer's obligations beyond the applicable agreement unless separately agreed.

## 5. Pre-existing intellectual property

The Developer retains ownership of independently created pre-existing material that is outside the ForgeFlow Work Product allocation. Before incorporating relevant pre-existing code, libraries, models, datasets, designs, documents, tools or other IP into ForgeFlow, the Developer must disclose it through the ForgeFlow Pre-Existing IP process.

If approved pre-existing material is incorporated into ForgeFlow, its treatment must be documented. Unless a different written treatment is approved, the Developer grants the Founder and any future ForgeFlow company a licence sufficient to use, modify, distribute and commercialize that material as part of ForgeFlow to the fullest extent permitted by law.

## 6. Third-party and open-source material

The Developer must not knowingly incorporate third-party code, models, datasets, fonts, images, documentation or proprietary materials unless the Developer has the right to use them and their licence is compatible with ForgeFlow policy.

Copyleft, source-available, non-commercial, research-only, custom, restricted or unclear licences require explicit review before incorporation. The Developer must not copy confidential or proprietary material from another employer, client, university, private repository or third party.

## 7. AI-assisted work

AI-assisted or generated output is treated as development material requiring human review. The Developer must not submit ForgeFlow secrets, confidential source, personal data, customer data or restricted third-party information to an AI provider unless that use is authorized.

The Developer remains responsible for reviewing AI-assisted output for provenance, licence risk, security, correctness and maintainability before contribution.

## 8. Confidential Information

**Confidential Information** includes non-public ForgeFlow source code, architecture, credentials, security information, product plans, business plans, pricing, customer or user information, internal documentation, prompts, models, data, infrastructure details and unreleased features.

The Developer will use Confidential Information only for authorized ForgeFlow work, protect it with reasonable care and not disclose it except as authorized. These obligations do not apply to information the Developer can demonstrate was lawfully public, already lawfully known without confidentiality restrictions, independently developed without ForgeFlow Confidential Information, or lawfully received from a third party without restriction.

## 9. Repository and system access

Access is personal, limited, revocable and provided only for authorized work. The Developer must not share credentials, bypass controls, retain unnecessary copies, commit secrets or provide access to another person.

Repository access, commits, pull requests, reviews, issue assignments, authorship attribution or contributor status do **not** create equity, partnership, revenue share, co-founder status, governance rights or commercial ownership in ForgeFlow. Any such right exists only if separately granted in a written agreement by the Founder.

## 10. Moral rights and attribution

Nothing in this Legal Pack purports to assign or waive moral rights that are non-transferable under Iranian law. Attribution and other non-transferable creator rights remain subject to mandatory applicable law.

This does not prevent ForgeFlow from exercising the economic rights, modification rights or development rights lawfully allocated to the Founder or a future ForgeFlow company.

## 11. Records and further assurances

The Developer will reasonably identify material authorship, pre-existing inputs and relevant third-party inputs when requested and will reasonably cooperate with records needed to confirm ownership, licences or registrations relating to Work Product.

## 12. Return, deletion and offboarding

When access ends or the Founder requests it, the Developer must stop using ForgeFlow systems and credentials and return or delete ForgeFlow Confidential Information and private source copies in the Developer's possession or control, except copies legally required to be retained or ordinary immutable backups not reasonably accessible in normal use.

Any permitted retained copy remains confidential and may not be used for another purpose. The Developer agrees to complete the ForgeFlow offboarding confirmation when requested.

## 13. No authority or ownership by implication

Unless separately authorized in writing, the Developer may not bind the Founder or ForgeFlow to contracts, licences, debt, employment commitments, public statements, equity promises or other obligations. Technical contribution alone does not create a partnership, joint venture or ownership interest.

## 14. Electronic acknowledgement

The parties intend the GitHub-account acceptance required by the ForgeFlow Legal Gate, together with GitHub's account identity, timestamp, pull-request record and retained versioned text, to form an electronic record of acknowledgement.

This mechanism does not claim to satisfy every possible higher evidentiary standard for a secure electronic signature. Higher-risk engagements may additionally require a dedicated e-signature service and retained audit certificate.

## 15. Governing law

This agreement is governed by the laws of the **Islamic Republic of Iran**. Mandatory Iranian labour, social-security, tax, intellectual-property and other non-waivable rules continue to apply according to the actual relationship between the parties.

Unless the parties later enter a valid separate dispute-resolution agreement, disputes are subject to the competent authorities and courts determined under applicable Iranian law.

## 16. Versioning

Acceptance applies only to Legal Pack version `2026-09-IR-2`. A material change requires a new version and fresh Legal Gate acceptance.
